note: Pre-2015 format: Answer any 5 of 10, all 10 marks, ~500 words each

questions.text: What do you mean by cognitive psychology? Describe the different domains of cognitive psychology.
Describe Atkinson and Shiffrin's Information Processing model of Memory.
Elucidate the neuropsychological basis of learning and memory.
Critically discuss the G and S factor theory and J.P. Dass theory of Intelligence.
Discuss the Nature of Intelligence. Delineate the historical perspective on individual differences and human ability.
What do you mean by creativity? Explain the different stages of creativity.
Critically discuss the Innateness theory of language acquisition.
What are developmental phonological disorders? Discuss specific language impairment.
The stages of problem solving (short note)
Characteristics of well defined and ill defined problems (short note)
Surface structure and Deep structure (short note)
